content.text: How do I include my crypto in my estate plan?

Digital asset inheritance requires careful planning around custody, key management, and access. Key questions: What types of assets (Bitcoin, ETH, NFTs, DeFi positions)? How are they currently stored (exchange, hardware wallet, multi-sig)? We can discuss strategies like social recovery, time-locked inheritance contracts, and secure key distribution. This is educational guidance; work with professionals familiar with digital asset regulations.
What happens to my NFTs when I die?

NFTs are controlled by private keys, so succession depends on key access. Options include: storing seed phrases in a secure vault with instructions, using multi-sig where beneficiaries hold partial keys, or smart contract-based dead man's switches. We should also consider gas fees for transfers and any royalty implications. What wallet and blockchain are your NFTs on?

all: Ask about specific asset types and custody methods
